load_mim_refiner_model: load a MIM-Refiner model by name using torch.hub and wrap it in MimRefinerWrapper
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass on an image tensor through the wrapped MIM-Refiner model to get cls and patch tokens
create_wrapper_class: create a MimRefinerWrapper class that wraps an nn.Module and forwards missing attributes to it
extract_patch_tokens: extract cls_token and patch_tokens from the MIM-Refiner model output by splitting and reshaping tensors
freeze_model_gradients: freeze model gradients by calling requires_grad_(False) after loading a MIM-Refiner model
